name: stay-picker
title: Stay Picker
description: A booking calendar for choosing a stay. Each night shows its price, sold-out nights are hatched, and the chosen range becomes one pill with a running total and a Reserve button.
use: A booking flow needs guests to pick a stay while seeing nightly prices and unavailable nights.
avoid: It shows one month at a time and has no text input, so far-off or flexible dates are slow to reach.
a11y: Arrow keys move between days and Enter picks, with prices and pressed state announced; the range pill itself is decorative. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded calendar card. A month heading with two chevrons sits above a Mo-Su grid where each day number carries a tiny nightly price, and sold-out days are hatched and struck through. Below the grid a status line sits over a Total figure and a Reserve pill.
behaves: Clicking a night starts a stay and a second click ends it, with the range drawn as one pill that wraps across week rows. Hovering previews the end night, sold-out nights are refused, and Reserve turns green once booked.
customise: Month, a nightly price and availability function, minimum nights, currency and a reserve callback are props; colours and the row height are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A month grid of buttons with a few layout animations; nothing runs when idle.
